answer: A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is collateralized vouching. Each new agent arriving at the network wharf must lock a stake, and established agents must vouch for it, like a vine that can climb only by anchoring to an existing trellis. Vouching is willow-like: flexible but rooted, since a vouching agent forfeits part of its own stake if the newcomer later misbehaves. Every fake identity thus costs real capital up front, and slashing burns that collateral, making mass sybil creation unprofitable.
